chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Al-Qasim ibn Yahya, from his grandfather Al-Hasan ibn Rashid, from Ibn Bukayr, who said:

We were in the presence of Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him). He fed us, then we raised our hands and said, 'The praise is for Allah.' Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said: 'O Allah, this is from You and from Muhammad, Your Messenger. O Allah, to You is the praise. Send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad.'
ai.seo_question: What is the proper supplication to say after eating according to Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him)?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) refines the companions' post-meal praise by explicitly linking the sustenance to both Allah and His Messenger, Muhammad (PBUH), before reciting a specific supplication for blessings upon the Prophet and his Ahl al-Bayt. This highlights the Shia emphasis on the Prophet's role as the intermediary of divine grace and the importance of invoking blessings upon his pure family as an integral part of gratitude. The practice underscores the spiritual etiquette of acknowledging both the Source and the Channel of sustenance in daily acts of worship.

en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Qasim Bin Yahya, from his grandfather Al Hassan Bin Rashid, from Ibn Bukeyr who said,

‘We were in the presence of Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>. So he<sup>asws</sup> fed us, then we raised our hands, so we said, ‘The Prais is for Allah<sup>azwj</sup>’. So Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! This is from You<sup>azwj</sup>, and from Muhammad<sup>saww</sup> Your<sup>azwj</sup> Rasool<sup>saww</sup>. O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! For You<sup>azwj</sup> is the Praise. Send Blessings upon Muhammad<sup>saww</sup> and the Progeny<sup>asws</sup> of Muhammad<sup>saww</sup>’.
en.sarwar: 22. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Qasim ibn Yahya from his grandfather al-Hassan ibn Rashid from ibn Bukayr who has said the following:

“Once we were with abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, and he (the Imam) fed us food then we stopped eating and said, ‘All praise belongs to Allah.’ Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, then said, ‘O Lord, this is from You and from Muhammad, Your messenger, O Lord, all praise belongs to you, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause.’”
